title: 長屋の空と、お節介な渡り鳥
author: 藤堂 小太郎

en.title: The Sky Above the Tenement and the Meddlesome Migratory Bird
en.premise: Genji is a blunt carpenter with a heart of gold. One winter day, an eccentric bird-lover from his tenement passes away, leaving behind a peculiar final request: to deliver a migratory bird to someone far away. Despite his grumbling, Genji finds himself racing through the streets of Edo with the bird in tow, uncovering the poignant secrets of the old man's hidden past.

zh.title: 长屋之空与爱管闲事的候鸟
zh.premise: 木匠源次虽然说话粗鲁，但内心却十分温柔。某个冬日，长屋里一位热爱鸟类的古怪老人离世，留下了一份奇特的“遗愿”：希望他能将一只冬日飞来的候鸟，送到远方的某人手中。源次虽然嘴上抱怨，但还是带着鸟在江户街头奔波，并在此过程中，逐渐揭开老人心中深藏的凄美往事。
